comment: sounds.c domonnoise() compares a peaceful humanoid's mhp with mhpmax / 4 and mhpmax / 2 in C integer arithmetic. A human Samurai in debug mode with a little dog creates a peaceful hobbit, searches twice while the dog bites it to 4 of 9 hit points, and chats with it: 4 < 9 / 2 is false in C, so the hobbit complains about the dungeon instead of asking for a potion of healing. The seed, the two waits and the chat direction come from a port scan of seeds 7360001-7360080 and 1-10 waits for an adjacent peaceful hobbit whose HP sits on one of these boundaries (seed 7360023 was the first with a live hobbit).
